# Panel

A tinted section of a screen: a heading and what it holds, on the tone's ground, outlined in its line.

<!-- rules:start — GENERATED by tools/build_tokens.py from design/components.json -->
## Rules (every product)

- Ground fill, line outline, corner nested (radius-tile + card-pad + outline).
- Its words start card-pad + outline in: the same text edge as every group and note on the screen.
- Something on a panel sits on that ground: a chip of the same tone turns paper, tiles turn paper.

Tokens: `component.panel` (fill, line) in design/tokens.json.

| Product | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Website | none: The website's full-width bands (lilac, butter, mint) play this part. |
| Design System | `.fmt-panel`, `<Panel>` |
| App | `FmtPanel` |
